subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the passage in no more than 90 to
stimulus: 100 words. 10 Read the passage and answer the questions 4 and 5. The battle of Palassey is one of the most notable incidents in the history of Bengal. It took place in 1757 and Nawab Sirajuddaula was defeated and, consequently, the British established their rule in India. In 1763, Meer Kashim tried to bring back the freedom of Bengal but failed. Robert Clive became the Governor of Bengal for the second time in 1765. After seven years, Warren Hastings came to Bengal and their British rulers made the Nawab powerless. In 1786, Lord Cornwallis was appointed the Governor of Bengal. He tried to make settlement of land. In 1773, Bengal went under the British rule fully. Then many governors came to Bengal and exploited the people living here. There rose a great Sepoy Mutiny in 1857 but ended in smoke. Thousands of people were killed and hanged brutally. Finally, we got back our independence in 1971 through a bloody war.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 02 — Mirzapur Cadet College, Tangail
